question.text: Which one of the following reactions is an example for calcination process?

options.text: <math><mn>2 </mn><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2 </mn><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mo>+</mo><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>→</mo><mn>2 </mn><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math>

solution.text: The process of heating the concentrated ore in the absence of air is known as calcination. The carbonate ore gets decomposed to form oxide of metal on calcination.
